product_notes.name: QueuePilot
product_notes.offer: Shared support inbox with rule-based routing and an audit history
product_notes.customers: UK B2B software support teams with 5-20 agents
product_notes.publication_intent: /support-routing is a public acquisition page. /app contains private tickets.

page_snapshot.title: Route support tickets | QueuePilot
body: Route new conversations to the right team using rules and keep a history of each handoff.
QueuePilot cuts customer resolution time by 70% for every team. See our pilot report [1].

source_snapshots.title: Routing pilot, September 2026
source_snapshots.text: In a two-week internal pilot involving two support teams, median manual assignment time fell from 10 to 3 minutes after enabling routing rules. Customer resolution time was not measured. This was an uncontrolled before/after comparison; no causal estimate was calculated.
